use_cases: Animated hero section background with organic wave patterns rendered in ASCII braille characters
Interactive landing page visualization that responds to mouse movement and clicks
Artistic portfolio or creative website decorative element with customizable colors and speed
ai_summary: A canvas-based animated ASCII visualization component that renders delicate wave patterns using Unicode braille and block characters. Features interactive mouse tracking and click-triggered ripple effects, with customizable grid density, animation speed, background and text colors. The ASCII characters fade in and out based on wave amplitude, creating a subtle, organic motion effect suitable for hero backgrounds or artistic landing page elements.
